paras: Our adjustable side skirt splitter winglets will bolt directly onto our FL5 Civic Type R side skirt splitters thanks to the pre-pressed in threaded brass fittings on our side skirt splitters. Fitting kit is provided to ensure perfect fitment and can be adjusted to your liking. Adjustments can be made anywhere between 5mm-20mm on each side increasing the overall width up to 40mm!
All products in the FL5 Civic Type R body kit range share the same technology used to produce our renowned WRX , Golf GTI and Focus RS line up - trusted by many car enthusiasts worldwide.
